messages.content: You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Brandon controls a phased out Wormfang Drake owned by Carroll. Carroll loses the game due to being attacked by Aubrianna. Does the Wormfang Drake trigger and return the card it exiled to the battlefield?
No. Objects that are phased out do not cause zone-change triggers to occur when they leave the game. (702.26k)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nathalie controls Worms of the Earth, and Abel has Scorched Ruins in their graveyard. Abel uses Eerie Ultimatum to attempt to return Scorched Ruins to the battlefield. What happens?
Nothing. Worms of the Earth says that lands can't enter the battlefield, so Scorched Ruins's replacement effect will never apply. (101.2, 614.17c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aspen controls a tapped Pack Mastiff enchanted with Nala's Sleeping Potion. What happens when Aspen activates Pack Mastiff's activated ability?

Nothing, other than the normal resolution of Pack Mastiff's ability. Pack Mastiff's ability doesn't use the word "target" and so while it has an effect on itself, it won't cause Sleeping Potion's ability to trigger. (115.1c, 603.2)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nylah controls a Containment Priest. Aydin plays a Dryad Arbor. What happens?
It's a nontoken creature and it wasn't cast (305.1), so it's exiled. It does not enter the battlefield. (614.6) Aydin may not play another land this turn.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Nico controls True-Name Nemesis with protection from Adriel. Adriel casts Mirrorweave targeting their Sewer Nemesis, for which Nico is the chosen player. After Mirrorweave resolves, if Adriel casts another spell, will Nico's True-Name Nemesis's third ability trigger?

No. Sewer Nemesis's second and third abilities are each "linked" to its first ability, and only the player named for the first ability is considered when checking to see if it triggers. (607.1, 607.2d) Since True-Name Nemesis didn't enter the battlefield as a copy of Sewer Nemesis, there is no chosen player for that ability. Since its power and toughness can't be determined, it's a 0/0. (107.2) If it were to stay alive somehow, it's third ability could never trigger.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn controls Essence of the Wild and casts Clone. Can they have the Clone enter the battlefield as a copy of Nancy's Ancient Brontodon?

No. Essence of the Wild and Clone both have replacement effects that want to modify how Clone enters the battlefield. Autumn, as the affected player, may apply them in whatever order they wishes. (616.1) Unfortunately neither order will result in Clone entering as a copy of Ancient Brontodon. If they applies Clone first, that ability will set Clone's copiable values to those of Ancient Brontodon. Then Essence of the Wild will set them to its own copiable values. If they applies Essence of the Wild first, that will set Clone's copiable values to Essence of the Wild. This will overwrite Clone's ability, so it will no longer apply.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aniya controls The Ozolith and Grazing Kelpie with a -1/-1 counter on it. What happens if Grazing Kelpie dies?

Grazing Kelpie will not return to the battlefield. The Ozolith will have a -1/-1 counter put on it. The Ozolith's ability does not remove counters from the creature, it just puts counters on The Ozolith matching the number and types of counters that the creature had on it when it died. (122.8) Persist will look back in time to determine if Grazing Kelpie had a -1/-1 counter on it at the time it died. Since it did, persist will not trigger. (603.10, 603.10a, 702.79a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Aidan crews their Captain America's Motorcycle. Nora activates their Hostile Desert causing it to become a creature. After that resolves, Nora casts Mirrorweave targeting their Hostile Desert. What are Captain America's Motorcycle's characteristics after Mirrorweave resolves?

It's a 0/0 colorless Land Artifact Creature - Desert and the abilities of Hostile Desert.

When Captain America's Motorcycle becomes a copy of Hostile Desert, it copies only the copiable values of the permanent, which does not include continuous effects like the one turning Hostile Desert into a creature. (707.2)

The effect from crew is still making Captain America's Motorcycle an artifact creature ([702.122a]), but it doesn't define a power and toughness, so the game treats it as 0/0. (208.5)

When the game checks state-based actions, it will die. (704.5f)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Addison controls Erratic Apparition and casts Impending Doom targeting their Thornhide Wolves. Before that resolves, Noemi destroys Thornhide Wolves. Will Impending Doom trigger Constellation?

No. On the stack an Aura is a targeted spell. (303.4a) If all of its targets are illegal before it resolves, it will be removed from the stack, and will not resolve, nor will it enter the battlefield. (303.4g, 608.3a, 608.3d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nehemiah controls Pharika's Chosen and 3 Headless Horsemans. Ana casts Alpha Brawl, targeting Pharika's Chosen. Which creatures survive?
None of them. Pharika's Chosen has deathtouch, and so kills all of the Headless Horsemans. (702.2b) The Headless Horsemans deal enough damage to the Pharika's Chosen that it dies as well.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Addison controls no creatures and casts Pack's Betrayal targeting Natalie's Tavern Smasher. Will they get to scry?

Yes. While resolving Pack's Betrayal Addison follows the instructions on the spell in the order written, so first Addison gains control of Tavern Smasher then the spell checks to see if they control a Wolf or Werewolf, which they now do. (608.2c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Adalyn controls Archetype of Imagination and Silverflame Squire. Nixon casts Sagittars' Volley targeting Archetype of Imagination. Will Silverflame Squire be dealt damage?

No. Sagittars' Volley will carry out its instructions in the order written on the card. (608.2c) First, Sagittars' Volley will destroy Archetype of Imagination, then it will deal one damage to each creature with flying that Adalyn controls. At this time, Adalyn controls no creatures with flying as the continuous effect that was granting Silverflame Squire flying is no longer on the battlefield. (611.3b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn controls Icetill Explorer. They plays 2 lands, then cast Personify targeting Icetill Explorer. After it resolves, can Autumn play a third land?
No. Land plays are not linked to any specific permanent, the game just looks at how many lands Autumn has played and how many Autumn is allowed to play in total. (305.2a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ari controls Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Chains of Mephistopheles. On Ari's turn, Nash has four cards in hand and casts Brainstorm. What happens as Brainstorm resolves?

Nash discards a card and then draws a card. Then Nash puts 2 cards from their hand on the top of their library.

Cards are drawn one at a time. (121.2) For Nash's first draw, Leovold, Emissary of Trest doesn't apply, since it's their first draw this turn, so Chains of Mephistopheles applies and makes them discard and then draw. Now they've drawn a card this turn, so Leovold, Emissary of Trest is "active". Their next two draws can't occur, so Chains of Mephistopheles's replacement effect is never applied. (614.17c) Then they finish resolving Brainstorm by putting two cards from their hand on top of their library.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Avalyn controls Obelisk of Urd enchanted with Disruption Aura. Can Avalyn tap six creatures instead of paying mana for Disruption Aura's triggered ability?

No. Convoke is an ability that functions while Obelisk of Urd is on the stack that allows Avalyn to tap creatures instead of paying mana for the Obelisk of Urd. (702.51a) It does not modify the mana cost of the spell in other zones, nor does it allow Avalyn to tap creatures to pay for Disruption Aura.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Arielle and Nick are starting a game. Nick puts a Leyline of Lightning onto the battlefield. Can Arielle now choose to put a Leyline of Sanctity onto the battlefield?

No. Each player, in turn order, gets one chance to take any opening hand actions they would like to take. (103.6) After the second player in turn order has made their choice, the first player does not get another opportunity.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariel casts Greater Good sacrificing their Bane Alley Blackguard which is enchanted with Torment. How many cards do they draw?
None. Greater Good checks the power of the creature on the battlefield, not in the graveyard. (109.2) If a player is instructed to draw a negative number of cards, they draw 0. (107.1b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nina controls Gaddock Teeg. Ameer has Conflagrate in their graveyard. Can they cast it for its flashback cost?
No. Even though Ameer is not paying {X} with mana, Conflagrate still has an {X} in its mana cost and is therefore not able to be cast due to Gaddock Teeg's second ability. (202.1)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nathaly controls Pithing Needle naming "Lightning Storm". Can Ashley cast Lightning Storm? If so, can they discard land cards to put charge counters on it?
Ashley can cast Lightning Storm, but cannot discard a land card to put charge counters on it. Discarding a land card is an activated ability, while casting a spell is not. (113.3b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alijah casts Vivify, turning their Snow-Covered Island into a creature. They then cast Time and Tide, phasing it out. If they cast Time and Tide again on the same turn, will it phase back in?
No. Continuous effects can't effect phased-out permanents, so it's not a creature while phased out. (702.26e)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Avalyn activates Grindstone targeting Nathaniel. In response they activate Goblin Welder, sacrificing Grindstone to return Painter's Servant to the battlefield. They choose "black" as the color for Painter's Servant, and still in response to the Grindstone ability, Nathaniel casts Veil of Summer. What happens?

Grindstone's ability will still resolve and mill Nathaniel's library. Hexproof from black cares about color of the source of the ability (702.11d), and since Grindstone isn't on the battlefield anymore, the game uses its last-known information to check the legality of the ability's target. (608.2b) Since it was colorless when it was last on the battlefield, hexproof from black doesn't affect it.

(The game doesn't care about its color in the graveyard because it's a new object there and has no relation to the permanent as it existed on the battlefield. (400.7))
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Nadia controls Zilortha, Strength Incarnate and Phyrexian Walker. Autumn attacks with Carnage Tyrant and Nadia blocks it with Phyrexian Walker. What is the maximum amount of damage that can be dealt to Nadia?

Seven. Zilortha, Strength Incarnate's ability means that for damage assignment purposes Phyrexian Walker is treated as if it has zero toughness. It therefore already has lethal damage marked on it, and Carnage Tyrant can trample over it for the full 7.

This does mean that Phyrexian Walker will remain alive, since it won't have any damage marked on it. (614.7a, 704.5g) If Autumn wants Phyrexian Walker to die, they will need to assign at least 1 damage to it and only 6 to Nadia.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aisha controls Hazezon Tamar and Omni-Changeling. Noah casts Flesh to Dust targeting Hazezon Tamar. Does Omni-Changeling get exiled by Hazezon Tamar's trigger?
Yes. It's a Sand and a Warrior. (702.73)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariah controls Wall of Wood and casts Biting Tether targeting Nico's Zilortha, Strength Incarnate. In response, Nico casts Cinderclasm to deal 1 damage to Wall of Wood. What happens to Wall of Wood?

Wall of Wood is destroyed after Biting Tether resolves, before any player gets priority. Damage from Cinderclasm indeed remains marked on Wall of Wood until end of turn (120.6) and the game checks to see if it is lethal each time state-based actions are checked. (704.3, 704.5, 704.5g)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Annalee casts Goatnap targeting Nico's Defiant Elf equipped with Nico's Seraphic Greatsword. After it resolves, Annalee attacks Nico, who has the highest life total, with Defiant Elf. Who controls the token created with Seraphic Greatsword's ability and who is the token attacking?
Nico still controls Seraphic Greatsword (301.5d), so they control the created token. As Nico is not the attacking player, the token is not attacking any player. (506.2, 506.3b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

In a multiplayer game, Avery controls Strixhaven Stadium with 9 counters on it. They attack Bethany and Chaim with one creature each, and no blockers are declared. When combat damage is dealt, who loses the game?

Avery chooses whether Bethany or Chaim loses. Strixhaven Stadium's ability triggers twice simultaneously. As Avery controls both triggers, they choose in what order they are put on the stack. (603.3b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alvaro controls Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn, which has lethal damage marked on it. Nico casts Scar, placing a -1/-1 counter on Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn. Will Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn die?

No. Since Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn has indestructible, it won't die due to having lethal damage marked on it. (702.12b) Having damage marked on it does not change a creature's toughness, so the -1/-1 counter will not cause it to die due to having 0 toughness, as its toughness is still greater than 0.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariel casts Genesis Wave, revealing Bioessence Hydra and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. How many counters will Bioessence Hydra have after everything has resolved?

Three. Bioessence Hydra's first ability is a replacement effect that modifies how it enters the battlefield, and won't take into account other permanents entering the battlefield with it (614.12). After it enters the battlefield, the game checks to see if anything has triggered (603.10) and it sees that three loyalty counters were put on Jace, the Mind Sculptor as it entered the battlefield. (122.6)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ansley controls Tobias Andrion, a token copy of Tobias Andrion produced by Twinflame, a 1/1 Saproling token created by Sprout Swarm, Hinterland Scourge, and a token copy of Hinterland Scourge produced by Stolen Identity. Nicolas casts Ratchet Bomb and activates its second ability. As Ratchet Bomb's ability resolves, what is destroyed?

The Saproling token and the token copy of Hinterland Scourge. Copy effects copy mana cost (707.2), so the token Tobias Andrion doesn't have a mana value of 0. Tokens that are created by an effect that sets their characteristics only have those characteristics. The Saproling token has no mana cost, so its mana value is 0. The mana value of transformed transforming double-faced cards is determined by their front face (712.8e), so the Hinterland Scourge isn't destroyed. Copies of double-faced cards have a mana value of 0. (712.8e)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ainsley activates the second ability of Sensei's Divining Top and would like to sacrifice it to Castle Doom before putting it on top of their library. Can they do this?
Yes. Ainsley can activate the second ability of Sensei's Divining Top and then sacrifice it to Castle Doom in response. When it resolves, Ainsley will just draw a card. (101.3)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Axel control Viscera Seer, Hateful Eidolon, and Pillarfield Ox enchanted by Blessing of the Nephilim. Axel activated Viscera Seer's ability sacrificing Pillarfield Ox to do so. This triggers Hateful Eidolon. In what order can Axel resolve these abilities?

Axel must draw then scry 1.

To activate Viscera Seer's ability, Axel puts that ability on the stack and pays the costs, sacrificing Pillarfield Ox in this case. (602.2) This triggers the ability of Hateful Eidolon. This triggered ability is then put onto the stack. Since the stack resolves in a first-in-last-out order, Axel must resolve the triggered ability then the activated ability in that order. (405.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ariel uses Glóin, Dwarf Emissary to goad Lazotep Behemoth. After it's been goaded, Natalia uses Perch Protection, causing Lazotep Behemoth to phase out. On Natalia's turn, what are Natalia's legal combat choices?

Lazotep Behemoth must attack, and since there aren't any other players in the game, it has to attack Ariel. Goaded creatures must attack, and must attack a player other than the one that goaded them if able. (701.15b) Phasing doesn't cause Lazotep Behemoth to no longer be goaded, as the duration on the continuous effect hasn't ended when Lazotep Behemoth phases back in. (702.26f)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Addison casts Chaos Warp targeting Noelle's commander. Noelle chooses to put it into the command zone instead of the library. Is Noelle's library shuffled? Do them reveal the card of their library and put it onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card?

Noelle does shuffle their library. (701.24c)

Noelle does reveal the top card. Chaos Warp doesn't care where the target moves to as it resolves, it simply instructs Noelle to do so.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ameer controls Loam Dweller and casts Kodama's Reach. Can they put both lands they find with Kodama's Reach onto the battlefield?
No. Loam Dweller's triggered ability will go on the stack above Kodama's Reach (601.2, 601.2i, 405.1/405.2) and will resolve first. (405.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aliana splice Evermind onto Crushing Pain. Can they target Soltari Priest with the spliced spell?
No. Evermind has a color indicator that makes it blue (204.1), and that will not be spliced onto Crushing Pain because it's not a part of its text box. (702.47a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alanna casts Sram's Expertise. As it resolves, they would like tap the tokens it created to cast Collective Effort escalated twice. Can they?

Yes. The instructions of a resolving spell are carried out in the order written (608.2c), so the tokens will be on the battlefield at that time. Tapping creatures for escalate is an additional cost. ([702.120a]) Alanna may still pay an additional cost for Collective Effort while casting it for the alternative cost given to it by Sram's Expertise. (118.9d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Albert, Bailey, and Christine are playing a multiplayer game. Bailey controls Emissary of Grudges. Albert casts Cruel Entertainment to take control of Bailey's next turn. After Bailey begins their turn, can Albert see which player was chosen for the Emissary of Grudges?

No. The choice was made as Emissary of Grudges entered the battlefield, which already happened- it's no longer visible to Bailey. (722.4) Albert can choose to activate the ability (at which point all players will know who was chosen), but otherwise the choice is not visible to any player.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Alex has no cards left in their library. Nico has 1 life. Alex controls Took Reaper, which is their ring-bearer. Alex has been tempted by the ring twice previously. If Alex attacks Nico, who wins the game?
Nico wins. When Took Reaper attacks, Alex must draw a card. (701.54c) This causes Alex to lose the game before the combat damage step is reached. (704.5b, 506.1)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariel casts Metamorphic Alteration targeting Nico's Spider-Ham, Peter Porker, choosing to copy Nico's Misty Knight, Hero for Hire. What happens?

Spider-Ham, Peter Porker becomes a copy of Misty Knight, Hero for Hire. Misty Knight, Hero for Hire's name is copied and therefore due to the legend rule, Nico will need to choose one to put into their graveyard. (707.2, 704.5j)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Adam, Bryleigh, and Carroll are playing a multiplayer game. Adam controls Extractor Demon and Bryleigh controls Kobolds of Kher Keep. Adam attacks Bryleigh and they lose the game. Does Extractor Demon trigger?
Yes. The game cares about the game state immediately before Bryleigh left the game. (603.10, 603.10a) At that point, Kobolds of Kher Keep was on the battlefield.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Amirah controls Tergrid, God of Fright and Rest in Peace. Nico discards Deadly Recluse. Can Amirah put Deadly Recluse onto the battlefield under their control?

No. Rest in Peace has a replacement effect that will cause Deadly Recluse to be exiled. (614.1, 614.1a) Tergrid, God of Fright's ability will trigger, but since Deadly Recluse isn't in the graveyard anymore, Amirah won't be able to put it onto the battlefield.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nayeli controls Ensnaring Bridge and has 2 cards in hand. Can Ari deal 3 damage to Nayeli by attacking with Duskmantle Prowler?

Yes. Ensnaring Bridge only prevents creatures with power > 2 from being declared as attackers. (508.1c) Exalted triggers after the creature attacks and gives it +1/+1. Nothing would remove it from combat at this point.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Andy casts Ashling's Command, with both modes targeting Nala. Will they be able to copy it with Radiate?

Yes. When the game checks to see if a spell targets a single permanent or player, it doesn't care how many times that object was targeted, only that it was the only object the spell targeted. (115.9c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Adrien controls Garruk's Packleader and casts Family Reunion twice. After they both resolve, they cast Lingering Souls. How many cards will they draw?
Zero. Family Reunion will only affect creatures that were on the battlefield at the time it resolved. (611.2c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ariya controls an Invasion of Ixalan with 1 defense counter on it. They attack it with Rankle and Torbran. If they choose the second mode for Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability, could they sacrifice Invasion of Ixalan's back face Belligerent Regisaur to it?

Yes. When Rankle and Torbran attacks Invasion of Ixalan and removes the last defense counter from it, both Invasion of Ixalan and Rankle and Torbran's abilities will trigger. (310.11b, 603.2b) Ariya will get to choose the order in which the abilities go on the stack, so they could put Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability on the stack first with Invasion of Ixalan's triggered ability on top. (603.3b) Invasion of Ixalan's triggered ability will resolve first, so Invasion of Ixalan will be exiled and Ariya could choose to cast it transformed. (608.1, 310.11b) When Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability resolves, Belligerent Regisaur will have resolved and be on the battlefield, so Ariya could choose to sacrifice it.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Adan controls Viashino Bey and Dragon Egg. Can they attack with just Viashino Bey?

Yes. When declaring attackers Adan must obey the maximum number of requirements while breaking the minimum number of restrictions. (508.1d) However, because Viashino Bey only requires that creatures attack if able, its ability doesn't apply to Dragon Egg because it isn't able to attack. (702.3b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Noa controls Yixlid Jailer. Albert uses Dralnu, Lich Lord to give Lich's Caress in their graveyard Flashback. Is Albert able to cast Lich's Caress from their graveyard to destroy Yixlid Jailer?

Yes. Both Yixlid Jailer and Dralnu, Lich Lord are applying a continuous effect to Lich's Caress, and both are being applied in layer 6. (613.1f) Since there is no dependency between the two effects, they are applied in timestamp order; Yixlid Jailer removes all abilities from Lich's Caress, which is then given flashback by Dralnu, Lich Lord. (613.3/613.7)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alec controls Heliod, the Warped Eclipse. Can Alec play Tanglepool Bridge during an opponent's turn?
No. Heliod, the Warped Eclipse allows Alec to cast spells as though they had flash. Playing a land is not the same as casting a spell. (305.1)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alfredo controls Reflections of Littjara naming "Beast" and casts Parcelbeast as a mutate spell targeting Dukhara Peafowl. What happens?

Alfredo creates a copy of Parcelbeast that's a mutating creature spell and is targeting Dukhara Peafowl. ([702.140a], [707.10]) As it resolves, it turns into a token and merges with Dukhara Peafowl. ([707.10f]/[608.3f], [702.140c]/[608.3d]) The merged permanent is a token if the token was put on top, and a nontoken otherwise. (729.2d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Does Neriah have a chance to cast Surgical Extraction after Autumn has drawn for turn but before they have a chance to cast a sorcery?
Yes. Players receive priority in the draw step after a card has been drawn. (504.2/500.3)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Agustin has Sivitri Scarzam and two Ichorids in their graveyard. On their upkeep, they resolve the trigger of the first Ichorid, exiling the second Ichorid. As the second trigger resolves, can Agustin choose to exile the Sivitri Scarzam? If so, what happens?
No. If Ichorid isn't in the graveyard when the trigger begins to resolve, it is removed from the stack. (603.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ari controls Protean Thaumaturge. They cast Eaten by Piranhas targeting their Loamdragger Giant. If they choose to have Protean Thaumaturge's triggered ability also target Loamdragger Giant, what will the characteristics of Protean Thaumaturge be?

Protean Thaumaturge will be a copy of Loamdragger Giant but will retain its triggered ability. Eaten by Piranhas will enter the battlefield and simultaneously change many of the characteristics of Loamdragger Giant. Afterwards Protean Thaumaturge's triggered ability will be put on the stack. (603.3) When Protean Thaumaturge's triggered ability resolves it will copy the copiable values of Loamdragger Giant. (707.2) The effects of Eaten by Piranhas do not modify the copiable values of Loamdragger Giant.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aspen casts and resolves Approach of the Second Sun. The game is then restarted with Karn Liberated. Aspen casts and resolves Approach of the Second Sun again. Do they win the game?
No. The restarted game is a completely new game. (726.1)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alessandro attacks with a Tuktuk the Explorer that was turned face-down by Ixidron and Naomi blocks with Gorilla Warrior. Does Tuktuk the Explorer trigger?

No. By default, triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event in question to see if they should trigger. (603.10) However, "leaves-the-battlefield" triggers check the game state immediately before the event instead. (603.10a) At that point, Tuktuk the Explorer had no abilities. (708.2)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ainsley controls Underworld Breach and has Honor the God-Pharaoh and two other cards their graveyard. Can they discard a card to its additional cost and then exile that card and the two others to cast it?
Yes. Costs to cast a spell can be paid in any order. (601.2h)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Angie casts Hour of Promise, finding Vesuva and Botanical Plaza. Can Vesuva copy Botanical Plaza?
No. The choice of what Vesuva can copy is made before it enters the battlefield (614.12a), and Botanical Plaza isn't on the battlefield yet at that time. (608.2f)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn is resolving the last chapter ability of Urza's Saga. Can they find Ancient Den?
No. Ancient Den has no mana cost, which is not the same thing as having a mana cost of {0}. (202.1b)
